title: Resume–Job Matcher
summary: A Flask app that scores how well a resume matches a job description and explains what's missing.
highlights: Score combines skill coverage (~100 skills and their spellings) with text similarity from scikit-learn
Lists missing skills, job terms the resume never mentions and what to fix first; safe PDF parsing
21 unit and API tests plus Playwright end-to-end tests on desktop and mobile; Docker image

title: Library Management Database
summary: A MySQL library system where stored procedures handle lending and returns, and triggers keep copy status and fines correct.
highlights: 3NF schema with CHECK, UNIQUE and foreign-key constraints; borrowing rules stored as data
15 months of history (2,200+ loans) replayed through the procedures; views for overdue books and member summaries
15 automated tests run on MySQL 8 in GitHub Actions

title: Retail Sales SQL Analysis
summary: A MySQL star-schema database for a 12-store retail chain, with 20 business questions answered in SQL and the findings charted.
highlights: CTEs and window functions (RANK, LAG, NTILE, moving averages) for growth, cohorts and RFM segments
Found that 20%+ discounts lose money on electronics and grocery, and that 26% of customers drive 54% of revenue
Every push rebuilds the database and runs all queries on MySQL 8 in GitHub Actions

title: Weather & Air-Quality Dashboard
summary: Live weather, a 5-day forecast and air quality on the Indian AQI scale for any city in India.
highlights: Converts PM2.5 and PM10 to India's AQI using CPCB breakpoints, with the official colour scale
City search with suggestions, geolocation, °C/°F and saved cities; hand-drawn SVG chart
Unit tests with Node's test runner and Playwright tests with the API mocked

title: Servisto
summary: A local service-provider marketplace where customers search for services and book providers.
highlights: Role-based authentication and session handling, with separate views for each role
Booking management with live status tracking and provider ratings
